title: Chapter 150 God Of Auxiliary
content:
Chapter 150 God Of Auxiliary

Seeing several figures coming from behind, everyone in the Divine Dynasty was extremely excited.

"It's the Divine General, the Divine General of our Divine Dynasty Empire!"

"Sword General, Shepherd General, they are all here!"

The leader was none other than the Sword God of the Divine Dynasty, Jian Xin!

At this moment, Jian Xin's face was somewhat ferocious. Facing the countless powerful Soul Devouring Clan armies, there was no trace of fear in his eyes, but the divine sword in his hand was shaking wildly.

"Those who violate our Divine Dynasty's territory will be punished no matter how far away they are!"

"Kill!"

Jian Xin shouted angrily, and then he charged directly into the battlefield with his sword.

Suddenly, the sword was in the air!

Countless terrifying sword intentions kept tearing the battlefield apart.

Seeing this scene, everyone in the Desolate City was also shocked.

This Divine Dynasty really cannot be underestimated. There are actually such powerful people.

And the most excited one must be Huang Shou.

Looking at Jian Xin holding the divine sword and killing people everywhere, Huang Shou looked excited.

If it weren't for the fact that the battle was still going on and it wasn't the right time, he would have wanted to pick up his sword and go forward to fight with the female sword god.

In the back, seeing that the second god general Jian Xin had already picked up his sword and killed, the other gods did not hesitate, and they all used their magical powers to kill into the battlefield.

After several super god-level gods of the Divine Dynasty joined the battlefield, the scene suddenly changed slightly.

The Soul Devouring Clan began to retreat step by step.

But even so, the people in the Divine Dynasty's deserted city did not show any joy.

Because the army that the Soul Devouring Clan came to support had not yet taken action.

At the border, after seeing the strength of the gods of the Divine Dynasty, Shi Chen smiled contemptuously.

Except for Jian Xin, who was slightly worthy of his attention, the rest of the people were just ants in his eyes.

"My men, kill!"

Shi Chen gave an order.

Immediately, the Soul Devouring Clan reinforcements that had just come from the void wormhole rushed directly to the battlefield.

Boom!

At this moment, the void began to break.

Obviously, this battle was too terrifying, and this starry sky could no longer support it.

On the other side, Mu Yu stood in the void, looking calmly at the terrifying Soul Devouring Clan army rushing into the battlefield.

Buzz——

At this time, the staff in his hand suddenly began to tremble.

Then Mu Yu began to chant ancient spells. After an unknown period of time, countless dense runes suddenly appeared on the entire battlefield.

The next moment, the countless runes began to glow and heat up.

Healing power!

In an instant, countless injured soldiers suddenly felt the recovery of their physical strength, and even their wounds began to heal without urging divine power.

Seeing this, everyone in the Divine Dynasty cheered: "It's General Mu, it's General Mu!!"

That's right, Mu Yu is not good at fighting, but in terms of controlling the battle situation, Mu Yu is the god of assistance!

At this moment, the morale of the soldiers of the entire Divine Dynasty soared.

Countless soldiers fought ten to one, slaughtering like crazy without caring about their lives.

At this time, Mu Yu was still waving the staff in his hand.

The next moment, a humming sound sounded.

A huge magic array covering the entire battlefield appeared in everyone's sight.

All the people in the God Dynasty's Desolate City who were in this array suddenly felt a continuous flow of power gushing out of their bodies.

Combat power blessing!

Feeling this, even the people in the Desolate City were shocked.

This God Dynasty actually has such a talent!

In a certain battlefield, A Wei looked deeply at Mu Yu outside the battlefield, and at this time, Gu Chen suddenly appeared beside A Wei.

"Brother Wei, do you have any ideas?"

Gu Chen wiped the blood off his face and smiled lightly.

Hearing this, A Wei smiled slightly and nodded.

"I think we should have such a person in Desolate City. I think the Lord of the City will think so if he sees it."

A Wei's words make sense.

Gu Chen nodded thoughtfully.

But, this is the city lord's wife's people.

Oh? Wait.

The pattern is small, the pattern is small.

The lady and the city lord are a family, so the lady's people are the city lord's people, and they are also the people of the deserted city.

Thinking of this, Gu Chen suddenly showed a smile, and then looked meaningfully at Mu Yu outside the battlefield.

"Brother Wei, don't worry, wait until the Soul Devouring Clan is destroyed, and then hand this person over to me."

Hearing Gu Chen's confident words, although Ah Wei was confused, he didn't say anything, just nodded.

At the same time, in the void, Mu Yu suddenly frowned slightly.

Someone is eyeing me?

No need to think, it must be the Soul Devouring Clan.

After all, my role is already very obvious. Unless the other party is a fool, he will never leave me alone.

Suddenly, Mu Yu looked at the Soul Devouring Clan with a serious expression, especially that Devouring Chen.

Shi Chen also noticed Mu Yu's gaze and immediately thought that the other party was provoking him.

"Damn it, I didn't intend to pay attention to you, but you are taking advantage of me."

At this time, a voice suddenly came from his ear.

"Shi Chen, kill that woman first!"

Hearing this, Shi Chen no longer hesitated, and then gave an order, and six super-god-level spirit-devouring clan strongmen suddenly appeared in front of Shi Chen.

"My lord."

Shi Chen pointed at Mu Yu in the starry sky in the distance, and said with murderous intent: "Kill that woman at all costs!"

At this moment, he also saw it.

With that woman, the opponent's overall strength even increased by half.

This data is extremely terrifying.

Originally, he had a huge advantage after the arrival of reinforcements, but with the woman holding the staff, he actually showed some signs of retreat.

After the voice fell, the six Soul Devouring Clan warriors disappeared without any nonsense.

In the battlefield, Jian Xin frowned slightly and was about to move.

At this time, several Soul Devouring Clan super-god realm warriors suddenly appeared around him.

The meaning is self-evident.

Seeing this, Jian Xin's eyes were filled with murderous intent.

Boom!

Suddenly, Jian Xin and the opponent started fighting directly.

But the opponent's goal was also achieved, and Jian Xin was directly held back.

At this moment, the rest of the people on the battlefield also noticed the Soul Devouring Clan's goal, but they scanned the battlefield and suddenly found that everyone had been held back by the Soul Devouring Clan warriors.

Seeing this scene, everyone secretly said that it was not good.

If Mu Yu had an accident at this time, their morale would definitely drop greatly. Their high-level combat power would not matter, but the low-level combat power would definitely suffer a devastating blow.

At that time, even if they won the battle, it would not mean much.

"Gu Chen!"

At this time, A Wei suddenly shouted.

Hearing A Wei's voice, Gu Chen immediately looked at A Wei.

"You go and protect that woman, leave this to me."

Hearing this, Gu Chen frowned.

He was now facing two super god realm strongmen.

And A Wei was facing three super god realm strongmen. Although there was no pressure, it was not easy to get out.

After all, the later the realm, the smaller the gap.

Unless it is very watery, if you want to crush the same level, you must be a real pride of heaven.
